title: staff-of-striking powerful-strike operation lacks typed per-charge damage representation
description:
Discovered during eshyra-jjti (exact-token dice conservation gate, PR #455 follow-ups): the family-match tolerance was hiding a representation question on `magic-item:staff-of-striking`.

The prose clause "For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 force damage" is C2-owned per the reviewed master inventory (docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md line ~299: "+1d6 force per charge (<=3): C2"), but the emitted record's mechanics carry no dice token for it: the `powerful-strike` operation has only `cost: [{economy: charges, amount: 'variable'}]` and the sole effect is the +3 attack/damage bonus. The daily recharge `1d6+4` conserves exactly and is unrelated.

Adjudicate under docs/importer-fix-protocol.md: either the operation should gain a typed per-charge damage representation (importer/curated-spec fix + pack regeneration), or source-backed evidence should document why a variable-cost operation without a damage formula is the reviewed representation. When resolved, remove the scoped exception `magic-item:staff-of-striking|forward|1d6` in packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts (the exhaustive used-exception assertion will fail if it goes stale, which is intended).

Note memory context: the o9bd 2026-07-01 reaudit found residual pack defects — re-verify the committed pack state before implementing.
notes:
## Supervisor adjudication (2026-07-21)

**Ruling: the operation gains a typed per-charge damage representation.** The
"no typed damage" state is a curation gap, not a reviewed representation.

Evidence. SRD 5.1 staff-of-striking: "When you hit with a melee attack using
it, you can expend up to 3 of its charges. For each charge you expend, the
target takes an extra 1d6 force damage." The master inventory
(2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3, line 299) classifies this "+1d6 force per charge
(<=3)" as C2 — mechanics-owned. Nothing in the reviewed record justifies
omitting it, and the near-identical sibling is already represented.

**Sibling precedent — Staff of Withering** ("expend 1 charge ... extra 2d10
necrotic damage on a hit"): `withering-strike` operation +
`c2-withering-strike-payload`, a `triggeredEffect` carrying nested
`extraDamage: { dice, type }`, `activation: { cost: 'free', trigger: 'hit with
staff' }`. Staff of Striking is the same shape with a variable cost, so it takes
the same representation. **Ring of Shooting Stars** is the precedent for the
variable-cost side: `cost: [{economy:'charges', amount:'variable'}]` plus
`activation.requirement: 'expend 1 to 3 charges'` prose.

Target representation:

    payload(
      'powerful-strike',
      'triggeredEffect',
      {
        trigger: 'hit with a melee attack using the staff',
        extraDamage: {
          dice: '1d6',
          type: 'force',
          perChargeExpended: true,
          maximumCharges: 3,
        },
      },
      [F2, F6, F9],
      { cost: 'free', trigger: 'hit with a melee attack using the staff' },
    )

Hook bindings drop F8 deliberately: there is no save DC or spell attack here.
Precedent for dropping it on no-save payloads is magicItemActivatedEffects.ts
lines ~151 ([F2, F6, F9]) and ~435 ([F6, F9]).

### Acceptance criteria

1. `magic-item:staff-of-striking` mechanics carry a `1d6` force damage token
   bound to `powerful-strike`, with the <=3 charge cap represented.
2. The scoped exception `magic-item:staff-of-striking|forward|1d6` is removed
   from `packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`; the exhaustive
   used-exception assertion still passes (it fails on a stale exception, which
   is the intended self-enforcement).
3. Pack regenerated through the importer; the generated diff touches only
   `magic-item:staff-of-striking`; `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` clean.
4. `npm run verify:worktree` clean.

### Out of scope (decided)

- **No typed maximum for variable operation costs.** Encoding "<=3 charges" as a
  schema-validated cost cap would touch every variable-cost item and the
  `costAmount` path in `packages/core/src/state/itemState.ts`. The reviewed
  precedent (Ring of Shooting Stars) keeps the cap as activation prose; here it
  is additionally carried as `maximumCharges` inside the damage payload. If a
  typed cost cap is wanted, that is its own bead.
- **No new nested-payload schema validation.** `triggeredEffect` validates only
  `trigger`/`result`/`condition`; nested payload keys are free-form across all
  existing magic items. Tightening that is a separate decision.
- Pack state re-verified before dispatch: `verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` reports the
  committed pack matches importer output exactly (0 records changed).
PR #469 open: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/469 (branch eshyra-u5wn at 29ffa5e). All four acceptance criteria met; scoped dice-conservation exception removed. Child eshyra-kdr5 closed. Leave this bead in_progress until the PR merges.
close_reason: PR #469 merged to main: typed per-charge damage representation for magic-item:staff-of-striking, scoped dice-conservation exception removed. Reviewer approved with no blocking findings.
